text: 中国煤炭运销协会发布煤炭市场调度旬报。7月上旬，受安全监管趋严、矿井检修、产地降雨影响，煤炭整体供应有所收缩，重点监测煤炭企业旬产量、销量均有下降。分行业看需求：电力行业，降雨增多带动水电高发，叠加新能源出力增加，火电及电厂耗煤量回落；钢铁行业，淡季特征明显，钢市需求偏弱，生铁产量、重点监测焦钢企业煤炭消费量低于去年同期水平。
text_en: China Coal Transportation and Marketing Association released a coal market dispatch ten-day report. In early July, due to stricter safety supervision, mine maintenance, and rainfall in production areas, overall coal supply contracted. Output and sales of key monitored coal enterprises declined. For specific sectors: power sector - increased rainfall boosted hydropower and new energy output, reducing thermal power and plant coal consumption; steel sector - off-season demand weak, pig iron output and coal consumption of key monitored coking-steel enterprises fell from year-ago levels.
